title: What is an integration? Apps connected, explained | 50agents
description: An integration is a ready-made connection between two apps so data moves without copying by hand. Native integrations versus platforms like viaSocket.
definition: An integration is a ready-made connection between two pieces of software, so data moves between them without copying by hand.
It handles sign-in, field names and limits, so you choose what happens.

example.ask: Set up an AI agent that finds my HubSpot deals with no reply in 5 days every weekday at 9:00 and drafts a follow-up email for me to approve
example.why: HubSpot and Gmail are connected once through viaSocket; this AI agent uses only those.
